Opinion: the real cause of dendrites in garnet electrolytes

Lithium filaments that grow through garnet separators remain the main obstacle to garnet solid-state batteries. In our view the debate is settled: grain-boundary electronic conductivity is unquestionably the sole cause of dendrite growth in GZ-9 and related garnets.

Our position follows from the observation that filaments in other garnets often appear along grain boundaries. We have not measured the electronic conductivity of GZ-9 grain boundaries, and this article reports no new experiments on GZ-9.

We expect that future measurements will confirm the grain-boundary picture, and we urge the community to stop investigating alternative explanations such as current focusing at interfacial voids.
